---
title: X6 React to a delay and a restriction
subtitle: 12:25–12:50 · 25 minutes
description: Re-plan after a two-week source delay and a rights restriction, keep the official deadline, record the decision, and export a Project view.
---

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**You produce:** two new sub-issues with dates and a dependency, an unchanged submission milestone, a decision record, a Project status update, and an exported view.
:::

## Why this step

Plans change. A good plan makes the change visible and traceable: what changed, why, what follows from it, and what did *not* change. In this exercise two events occur at once. You react with the tools from X2 to X5.

The most important rule is about deadlines. The submission date of a master's thesis is an official date. Only the supervisor can extend it, once, for a serious reason ([RSL Phil.-hist. 21 Art. 56 Abs. 2](../../documentation/requirements.qmd)). A late submission is graded 1 (Art. 56 Abs. 4). You therefore **never move the official deadline in the plan to absorb a delay**. You move the planned work, you check what still fits, and you record the decision.

## The scenario

::: {.callout-important}
## 16 October 2026, 12:25 (fictional)

1. **Delay.** The fictional archive delivers the scans two weeks late: on 2027-01-29 instead of 2027-01-15.
2. **Restriction.** The archive restricts reuse of the scans of record **SYN-P021**. They must not appear in any public output.
:::

## Steps

### Update the scope

1. Open the epic E08 and click **Create sub-issue**.
2. Create `E08-T6 Receive the scans from the fictional archive` with the label `kind:task` and milestone M2.
3. Create `E08-T7 Exclude the restricted scans of SYN-P021 from public outputs` with the label `kind:task` and milestone M2.
4. Write acceptance criteria for both. Use the [example](#example-acceptance-criteria) below.

### Apply the delay

1. Open the Project and the view **Backlog**.
2. Set E08-T6: Start date `2027-01-04`, Target date `2027-01-29` (originally `2027-01-15`).
3. Set E08-T7: Start date `2027-02-01`, Target date `2027-02-12`.
4. Open E08-T7 and mark it as **blocked by** E08-T6.
5. Open the view **Roadmap**. Check that both bars end before the marker of M2 (2027-03-01).
6. Check that M3 (2027-06-01) did not move.

### Record the decision

1. Open `project-management/decisions.md` and click the pencil icon.
2. Add the [decision text](#decision-text) below at the end.
3. Commit with the message `docs: record the decision on the delay and the restriction`.

### Report the status

1. In the Project header, click **Add status update**.
2. Select the status **On track**, the start date `2026-10-19`, and the target date `2027-06-01`.
3. Write two sentences: what changed and what did not change. Name the decision D-T02.
4. Click **Post update**.

{{< screenshot x6-status-update >}}

### Export a view

1. Open the view **Backlog**.
2. Click the arrow next to the view name.
3. Select **Export view data**.
4. Save the CSV file. It is a snapshot of the plan for your records or your supervisor.

{{< screenshot x6-export >}}

## Texts to copy

### Example acceptance criteria {#example-acceptance-criteria}

```markdown
**E08-T6** Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The archive delivered every requested scan.
- [ ] The archive stated the reuse terms per record.

**E08-T7** Acceptance criteria
- [ ] No public file contains a scan of SYN-P021.
- [ ] The data dictionary explains the restriction.
```

### Decision text {#decision-text}

```markdown
## D-T02 Two-week delay of the scans and a reuse restriction

- **Date:** 2026-10-16 (workshop; fictional)
- **Context:** The fictional archive delivers the scans two weeks late. It restricts reuse of the scans of record SYN-P021.
- **Decision:**
  - Move the target date of E08-T6 (receive the scans) from 2027-01-15 to 2027-01-29.
  - Add E08-T7: exclude the scans of SYN-P021 from all public outputs. E08-T7 is blocked by E08-T6.
  - Keep milestone M3 (submission, 2027-06-01) unchanged.
- **Consequences:** M2 (2027-03-01, proposed) still holds. No public file contains a scan of SYN-P021.
- **Not changed:** The official submission date. Only the supervisor can extend it (RSL Phil.-hist. 21 Art. 56 Abs. 2).
```

## Expected state

- [ ] E08 has five sub-issues; E08-T7 shows "Blocked by: E08-T6".
- [ ] The roadmap shows E08-T6 ending on 2027-01-29 and both new tasks before M2.
- [ ] M3 still has the due date 2027-06-01.
- [ ] `decisions.md` holds D-T02.
- [ ] The Project header shows a status update.
- [ ] You saved an exported CSV of the Backlog view.

## If something goes wrong

| Problem | Cause | Recovery |
| --- | --- | --- |
| A bar ends after the M2 marker. | The delay does not fit. | M2 is a proposed date: move M2 and record why. Never move M3. |
| **Add status update** is missing. | The window is narrow. | Open the Project menu (**…**) or widen the window. |
| **Export view data** is missing. | You opened the wrong menu. | Use the small arrow on the view tab, not the **View** button. |
| You moved M3 by mistake. | — | Set the due date back to 2027-06-01. The Issue history shows the change. |

## Alternatives

- **Pair:** discuss first whether the delay endangers M2. Then one person edits the Project, the other writes the decision.
- **Private path:** identical. A status update in a private Project is visible only to people with access.
